column3: Preserves giving everything rather than “left” as an inheritance.
Preserves “days of the years of Abraham’s life” and the repeated years.
Preserves the final singular subject and settlement before his brothers, without adding “hostility”.
Preserves the initial conditional “If so” in her question.
Preserves living in tents rather than “stayed at home”.
Preserves “game was in his mouth” rather than paraphrasing a taste for game.
Preserves the repetition “red, this red” and weariness rather than adding extreme hunger.
